summary: Chilwa Minerals Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching its 30 October 2026 ASX announcement titled 'Nakombe Niobium-Yttrium Assays Strengthen Discovery.' The filing is an ordinary exploration update, not a special situation: laboratory ICP-MS assays from diamond holes MPYDD009 and MPYDD015 at the Nakombe target within the Lake Chilwa licence in southern Malawi returned 57 metres at 0.315% Nb2O5 from surface and 22 metres at 0.243% Nb2O5, with yttrium-rich rare-earth co-enrichment. An infill program and maiden Mineral Resource Estimate planned for May–June 2027 are flagged. No transaction, capital event or board change is disclosed; watch resource-confirmation drilling.
